question.name: The Unwelcome Landscaper
question.text: A young villager insists that the Tree of Life needs a personal gardener and begins arranging stones, flowers, and moss around its roots.

choices.label: Ask the gardener to consult the elders first.

a1.text: The arrangement improves drainage and protects fragile seedlings.

a2.text: The gardener accidentally blocks a water channel. The villagers correct the mistake together.

a3.text: The flowers attract colorful insects, delighting the children.

b1.text: The gardener learns how carefully the Tree must be tended.

b2.text: An elder adopts the idea and creates a shared gardening ritual.

b3.text: The gardener sulks, then returns with a detailed sketch that impresses the builders.
